rows.role_title: King (Custodian of The Two Holy Mosques)
rows.text: Release dated January 1, 1996 on the Royal Embassy's January 1996 page: 'The Custodian of The Two Holy Mosques King Fahd Bin Abdulaziz directed the following Royal Decree to Crown Prince His Royal Highness Prince Abdullah Bin Abdulziz, the deputy Premier and head of the National Guard'.
rows.locator: January 1996 page; item 'KING FAHD DELEGATES CROWN PRINCE TO UNDERTAKE STATE'S AFFAIRS', date line and first sentence

rows.text: The same release addresses the decree to 'Crown Prince His Royal Highness Prince Abdullah Bin Abdulziz, the deputy Premier and head of the National Guard' and prints his reply as from 'the Crown Prince, His Royal Highness Prince Abdullah Bin Abdul Aziz'.
rows.locator: January 1996 page; same item, first and second paragraphs

rows.text: The decree, 'after reviewing article 65 of the basic system of Government', says: 'we hereby delegate your Highness to undertake the affairs of the state while we enjoy rest and recuperation'; the Crown Prince's reply accepts the delegation 'to run the affairs of the state on your behalf'.
rows.locator: January 1996 page; same item, decree text and reply
